name: AND–OR graph with a dead end (futility)
note: A has two connectors: B (looks cheapest, 1 + h 1 = 2) or AND{C,D} (2 + 1 + 1 = 4). AO* marks B and expands it: B has no connectors, so it is a dead end with cost FUTILITY, and A is revised to use AND{C,D}. C and D then expand to solved leaves: A is solved with cost 4 and the solution graph is A, C, D, K1, K2 (B is abandoned).
